ios.desc:
Learning is better when it’s fun, interactive, and personal. Recallie AI transforms your notes, photos, and documents into interactive courses, flashcards, and quizzes so you can learn anything, anytime, just like Duolingo but beyond languages.
Whether you’re preparing for exams, brushing up on skills, or exploring a new subject, Recallie AI gives you a playful learning journey with streaks, levels, and progress tracking to keep you motivated.

-------------

Why Recallie AI?

• AI-Powered Course Generation
   Upload notes, photos, or documents, and Recallie instantly turns them into structured courses with lessons, flashcards, and quizzes.
•  Spaced Repetition Flashcards
   Strengthen your memory with smart flashcards designed to help knowledge stick.
•  Playful Learning Journey
   Stay consistent with streaks, levels, and a Duolingo-style journey map that makes studying feel like a game.
•. Smart Organization
   Create folders, track your progress, and manage multiple courses with ease.
•. Personalized Experience
   Choose your avatar, colors, topics, and pace for a study routine that fits your goals.

-------------

Perfect For:

• Students of all ages preparing for exams.
• Professionals learning new skills.
• Lifelong learners curious about any subject.
• Anyone who wants to stay consistent and make learning stick.

-------------

What Makes Recallie AI Stand Out?

Unlike traditional apps with fixed lessons, Recallie is personal. Your learning journey starts with your own content,  notes, documents, photos and our AI turns it into something engaging, structured, and effective. With proven memory techniques like spaced repetition, Recallie helps you retain knowledge longer while enjoying the process.


Important Information for Users:
https://recallieai.app/privacy-policyRecallie AI requires a subscription to access the app. Subscriptions unlock all features, including course generation from notes, documents, and photos, interactive quizzes, flashcards, streak tracking, and progress insights.

quotes.text:
I built an app with a Duolingo-style structured learning system where users can generate full courses from photos, documents, or typed input. Each course includes quizzes, flashcards, and notes, and users can also turn their notes into an AI-generated podcast for audio learning.

It’s designed to help students and anyone who wants to learn a topic study smarter and retain more through interactive lessons, quizzes, and podcasts tailored to their learning style.

Built with React Native Expo.

https://youtu.be/jsRk1vN1xNA?si=iMGZFhj_N2iwBp5n
